description: Merchant profiles for catalog v2 (scripts/build-catalog-v2.mjs). Facts come from docs/research/cashback-card-terms-2026.md (checked 2026-09-28). MCCs are predictions: none of the seven cards pays a bonus on the expected codes, so the channel test (Amex online retail) is what decides the recommendation.

sources.title: CheckMCC: Best Buy (community MCC lookup, undated)

merchants.name: Best Buy
merchants.notes: MCC 5732 (electronics stores) comes from an undated community lookup only. Online orders qualify as online retail only when paid online; buy online, pick up in store counts only if Best Buy codes it as online. Geek Squad services and protection plans may count as services, not retail.

merchants.name: Newegg
merchants.notes: MCC 5732 (electronics stores) comes from an undated community lookup only. Newegg Marketplace third-party sellers may post differently; no evidence either way.

merchants.name: Amazon
merchants.notes: No MCC evidence was collected. American Express names Amazon.com as an eligible online retailer and says online superstores such as Amazon are not supermarkets. Items from third-party marketplace sellers may post differently; digital goods and services are not physical goods.
